instruction: Recover poster_party_night.webp from the Trash and move it to the Pictures folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully recovered poster_party_night.webp from Trash to Desktop using Nautilus file manager. Opened file manager via Activities search, navigated to Trash, right-clicked file and selected Restore From Trash.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Nautilus file manager, use Activities search, access Trash, restore files via right-click context menu, manage files on Desktop
metadata.task_rationale: Extends the original recovery task by requiring an additional step: moving the file to a different folder after recovery. Tests file management beyond simple trash restoration.
metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering the poster from Trash and then moving it to the Pictures folder. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp using exact_match on shell command output.
